question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE date('2026-09-26') >= date(c.birth_date, '+25 years')
  AND date('2026-09-26') < date(c.birth_date, '+26 years');

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-26
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > '09' THEN 1
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09' AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '26' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) = 25;

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.customer_id IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customers
    WHERE birth_date IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          -- Exactly 25 years old on 2026-09-26
          strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-26') = strftime('%Y-%m-%d', birth_date, '+25 years')
          OR
          -- Handle cases where the birthday hasn't occurred yet in the 25th year
          (strftime('%m-%d', birth_date) > strftime('%m-%d', '2026-09-26')
           AND strftime('%Y', birth_date, '+25 years') = '2026')
          OR
          -- Handle cases where the birthday has occurred in the 25th year
          (strftime('%m-%d', birth_date) <= strftime('%m-%d', '2026-09-26')
           AND strftime('%Y', birth_date, '+25 years') = '2026')
      )
);
